en: In the beginning, God created the rising sun and the earth.
nv: hodeeyáádą́ą́ʼ diyin god yótʼááh hiníláii índa nahasdzáán áyiilaa.

en: The earth was without form, and nothing existed upon it;
nv: nahasdzáán tʼáadoo ánoolniní da, índa tʼáadoo bikááʼ siláhí da;

en: While there was just darkness upon it, the Holy Spirit of God moved over the surface of the water.
nv: bikáaʼgi tʼáá átʼéé nítʼééʼ chahałheełgo diyin god biníłchʼi diyinii tó yikááʼgóó nahazleʼ.

en: And God said, “let there be light.” Just then, the light became.
nv: áádóó diyin god ádííniid, adinídíin leʼ. tʼáá áko adinídíín hazlį́į́ʼ.

en: Then God seeing the that the light was good, and he separated the light from the darkness.
nv: áko diyin god éí adinídínígíí yinééłʼį́įʼgo bił yáʼíítʼééh, áádóó adinídínígíí chahałheeł yił ałtsʼáyíínil.

en: Then God called the light day; the darkness he called night. Then night became and day became marking the first day.
nv: áko diyin god éí adinídínígíí jį́ yee yiyíízhiʼ; chahałheełígíí éí tłʼééʼ yee yiyíízhiʼ. áko tłʼééʼ hazlį́į́ʼ áádóó jį́ hazlį́įʼjįʼ áłtsé łaʼa jį́ azlį́į́ʼ.

en: Afterwards God said again, “let there be an expanse to separate water on either side.”
nv: nááʼákóneʼ diyin god ánáádooʼniid, tá ałnííʼ góneʼ hazʼą́ wóleʼgo tó ałtsʼą́ą́hjí hólǫ́ǫ, leʼ.

en: Then God made the expanse separating the the waters above and the waters below;
nv: áko diyin god éí wódahdi tóhígíí áádóó wóyahdi tóhígíí bitaʼgi hazʼą́ągo éí yee ałtsʼáyíínil;

en: Jesus Christ is from the lineage of David, and David is from the lineage of Abraham.
nv: jesus christ éí david bitsʼą́ą́dóó oochíiłii nilį́, áádóó david éí éíbraham bitsʼą́ą́dóó oochíiłii nilį́.

en: Thus, this is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ. Abraham for whom Isaac was born, and Isaac for whom Jacob was born, thereafter Jacob for whom Judah and his brothers were born,
nv: kótʼéego jesus christ bizází yę́ę náás daʼahílchį́. éíbraham éí áízak há yizhchį́, áádóó áízak éí jéíkab há yizhchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ jéíkab éí júdah áádóó bikʼisóó há niheezhchį́,

en: and next Tamar gave birth to Perez and Zerah for Judah, and after that Perez for whom Hezron was born, and after that Hezron for whom Ram was born,
nv: áádóó ákóneʼ téímar éí píírez índa zíírah, júdah bá jishchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ píírez éí hézran há yizhchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ hézran éí ram há yizhchį́,

en: and there Ram for whom Amminadab was born, and after that Amminadab for whom Nahshon was born, next Nahshon for whom Salmon was born,
nv: áádóó áadi ram éí amínadab há yizhchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ amínadab éí náshan há yizhchį́, ákóneʼ náshan éí sálman há yizhchį́,

en: afterwards Salmon for whom Boaz was born by Rahab, Boaz for whom Obed was born by Ruth, and there Obed for whom Jesse was born,
nv: nááʼákóneʼ réíhab éí bóʼaz, sálman bá jishchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ ruth éí óbed, bóʼaz bá jishchį́, áádóó áadi óbed éí jésii há yizhchį́,

en: there also Jesse for whom king David was born. And after that David for whom Solomon was born by Uriah’s wife,
nv: áadi índa jésii éí david aláahgo naatʼáanii há yizhchį́. áádóó bikʼijįʼ yoráíyah beʼasdzą́ą́ nítʼéʼígíí éí sálaman, david bá jishchį́,

en: and after that Solomon for whom Rehoboam was born, next Rehoboam for whom Abijah was born, and there Abijah for whom Asa was born,
nv: áádóó bikʼijįʼ sálaman éí riihobówam há yizhchį́, ákóneʼ riihobówam éí abáíjah há yizhchį́, áádóó áadi abáíjah éí éísa há yizhchį́,

en: and after that Asa for whom Jehoshaphat was born, then Jehoshaphat for whom Joram was born, and afterwards Joram for whom Uzziah was born,
nv: áádóó bikʼijįʼ éísa éí jiiháshafat há yizhchį́, ákóneʼ jiiháshafat éí jiihóram há yizhchį́, áádóó nááʼákóneʼ jiihóram éí azáíyah há yizhchį́,

en: and there Uzziah for whom Jotham was born, and after that Jotham for whom Ahaz was born, and afterwards Ahaz for whom Hezekiah was born,
nv: áádóó áadi azáíyah éí jótham há yizhchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ jótham éí éíhaz há yizhchį́, áádóó nááʼákóneʼ éíhaz éí heziikáíyah há yizhchį́,

en: and there Hezekiah for whom Manasseh was born, and after that Manasseh for whom Amon was born, and afterwards Amon for whom Josiah was born,
nv: áádóó áadi heziikáíyah éí manáseh há yizhchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ manáseh éí éíman há yizhchį́, áádóó nááʼákóneʼ éíman éí josáíyah há yizhchį́,

en: there also at the time of the deportation to Babylon Josiah for whom Jeconiah and his brothers were born.
nv: áadi índa bábilangóó hoʼdisnááh yę́ędą́ą́ʼ josáíyah éí jekonáíyah índa bikʼisóó há niheezhchį́.

en: And also after the deportation to Babylon Jeconiah for whom Shealtiel was born, there also Shealtiel for whom Zerubbabel was born,
nv: áádóó índa bábilangóó hoʼdisnááhdóó bikʼijįʼ jekonáíyah éí shiyáltiyel há yizhchį́, áadi índa shiyáltiyel éí zerábabel há yizhchį́,

en: and then Zerubbabel for whom Abihud was born, afterwards Abihud for whom Eliakim was born, and after that Eliakim for whom Azor was born,
nv: áádóó ákóneʼ zerábabel éí abáíyad há yizhchį́, nááʼákóneʼ abáíyad éí iiláíyakim há yizhchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ iiláíyakim éí éízor há yizhchį́,

en: afterwards Azor for whom Zadok was born, and also Zadok for home Akim was born, and after that Akim for whom Eliud was born,
nv: nááʼákóneʼ éízor éí zéídak há yizhchį́, áádóó índa zéídak éí éíkim há yizhchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ éíkim éí iiláíyad há yizhchį́,

en: afterwards Eliud for whom Eleazer was born, and after that Eleazer for whom Matthan was born, and Matthan for whom Jacob was again born,
nv: nááʼákóneʼ iiláíyad éí eliyéízer há yizhchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ eliyéízer éí máthan há yizhchį́, índa máthan éí jéíkab há náánázhchį́,

en: Jacob for whom Joseph was born, then Joseph became Mary’s husband. Mary gave birth to Jesus, who was called Christ.
nv: jéíkab éí jóseph há yizhchį́, áko jóseph éí mary bahastiin silį́į́ʼ. mary éí jesus, christ wolyéhígíí, jishchį́.

en: From when Abraham lived to when David lived are fourteen generations, and from when David live to the deportation to Babylon are fourteen generations, and from the deportation to Babylon to the birth of Christ are fourteen generations.
nv: áko éíbraham hiná yę́ędóó david hiná yę́ęjįʼ dį́į́ʼtsʼáadahdi ałkʼi náʼázhchį́, áádóó david hiná yę́ędóó bábilangóó hoʼdisnááh yę́ęjįʼ dį́į́ʼtsʼáadahdi ałkʼi náʼázhchį́, ákóneʼ bábilangóó hoʼdisnááh yę́ędóó christ yizhchį́įjįʼ dį́į́ʼtsʼáadahdi ałkʼi náʼázhchį́.

en: So, Jesus Christ was born this way. When his mother Mary was engaged to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be pregnant through the Holy Spirit.
nv: jó, kótʼéego jesus christ hoʼdizhchį́. hamá mary éí jóseph yił ahaa dootʼashgo yił ahaʼdeetʼą́, nidi tʼah doo yił ahaítʼaashgóó, níłchʼi diyinii bibee adziilii bee izʼniiltsąądgo bééhoozin.

en: Then Joseph, her husband to be, since he was a righteous man, intended to divorce her privately to because he did not want to disgrace her.
nv: áko jóseph, hahastiin dooleełígíí, diné tʼáá ákogi átʼéii nilį́įgo, tʼáá nahonitʼinee nahjįʼ nihodideeshʼáałgo doo haa yáhodoosįįł da niizį́į́ʼ.

en: When he had contemplated this, and angel of the Lord appeared to him in a vision and said, “Joseph, son of David, Do not fear taking Mary as your wife, because she is pregnant by means of the Holy Spirit.”
nv: nidi díí yaa nitsíkees nítʼééʼ nayiiyeełgo bóhólníihii bidiyingo naalʼaʼí bichʼįʼ yitʼíní íʼdiilyaago ábíłní, jóseph, david biyeʼ nílíinii, mary neʼasdzą́ą́ yileehígíí tʼáadoo bikʼee nił yéʼí, háálá níłchʼi diyinii bibee adziilii bee izʼniiltsąąd.

en: Then she will give birth to a boy, and you will call him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.
nv: áko ashkii yidoołchííł, áádóó jesus bee yídíízhiił, háálá bidineʼé bibąąhági ádaatʼéii yitsʼą́ąjįʼ yisdéidiyoonił.

en: This happened for the purpose of fullfilling what was spoken by the Lord through the prophet:
nv: diyin god yá halneʼii binahjįʼ bóhólníihii hahaasdzíiʼii ałtso bohodoolnííł biniyé ádzaa:

en: “Behold, the virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and they will call him Emmanuel, (which means God with us).”
nv: jóʼakon, chʼikę́ę́h tʼah doo diné bee haleehii awééʼ bee hodooleełgo ashkii yidoołchííł, éí imányowel bee yídóojiił, (éí diyin god nihił hólǫ́ jiníigo óolyé).

en: Joseph awoke from sleep, he did what the angel of the Lord said, he took Mary,
nv: nítʼééʼ jóseph tsʼéédzídzidgo nízhdiiʼnaʼ, áko bóhólníihii bidiyingo naalʼaʼí áhodííniidii biʼjiilaago, mary bił ahaa jítʼáázh,

en: but they did not have sexual relations until she gave birth to their son, and they named him Jesus.
nv: nidi tʼáadoo baa níjítʼįįhí biyáázh yishchį́, áádóó jesus bee jíízhiʼ.

en: At the time of King Herod in Judea Jesus was born in Bethlehem, so then, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem saying,
nv: hérad aláahgo naatʼáanii nilį́įgo yoołkááł yę́ędą́ą́ʼ judíya kéyah biyiʼ béthlehemgi jesus yizhchį́, nítʼééʼ jóʼakon, haʼaʼaahdę́ę́ʼ jerúsalemjįʼ hastóí dahóyáanii yíkaigo kódaaní,

en: “Where was the king of the Jews born? For, in the east we saw his star, then we came to worship him.”
nv: háadiyeeʼ jew dineʼé aláahgo binanitʼaʼí yizhchį́? jó, haʼaʼaahdi bisǫʼ deiiltsą́, áko bichʼįʼ nidahodiidlaał biniyé niikai.

en: When King Herod heard this he was alarmed, and all the residents at Jerusalem were likewise,
nv: hérad aláahgo naatʼáanii nilíinii díidí yidiiztsʼą́ąʼgo niseeltłah, áádóó jerúsalemgi kéédahatʼíinii ałdóʼ tʼáá ałtso ákódaadzaa,

en: then he assembled all the chief priests and those who teach the law and asked Christ’s birth place.
nv: áko aláahgo náádaʼiiłniihii índa bee hazʼáanii yíndaʼniłtinii tʼáá ałtso áłah áyiilaago háadi christ doochíłígíí yínaʼídééłkid.

en: They said, “within the land of Judea in Bethlehem, for the prophet wrote this:”
nv: nítʼééʼ ádahodííniid, judíya kéyah hoolyéii biyiʼ béthlehemgi lą́ą, háálá kótʼéego diyin god yá halneʼii yee akʼeʼashchį́:

en: In the land of Judah you who are Bethlehem, in Judah leaders from among them are not the least, for from out of you a leader will come to lead my people Israel.
nv: júdah bikéyahgi béthlehem nílíinii, júdahgi naatʼáanii danilíinii bitahdóó doo akéédę́ę́ʼ ánítʼée da, háálá nitsʼą́ą́dóó naatʼáanii shidineʼé ízrel yooʼish dooleełii chʼídoogááł.

en: Herod summoned the wise men, and he determined exactly when they saw the star.
nv: nítʼééʼ hérad éí hastóí dahóyáanii yíkaígíí tʼáá nantʼinee hágo yidííniidgo, tsʼídá haaʼí hoolzhishgo sǫʼ dajiiłtsánígíí hatsʼą́ą́dóó bił bééhoozin.

en: Then sending them to Bethlehem he said, “Go and look, carefully for the child, then when you reach him inform me the news, then I also can go worship him.”
nv: áko béthlehemgóó hoʼníłniiʼgo áhodííniid, nihílááh, tsʼídá haleebee awééʼ hadanohtá, áko bikʼínohkaigo haneʼ shaa nídadoohʼááł, áko shí ałdóʼ ákǫ́ǫ́ deesháałgo bichʼįʼ nahodeeshłaał.

en: After listening to the king they left, once again, the star that they saw rose again until it stopped above where the child was.
nv: aláahgo naatʼáanii áhodííniidígíí dazdiiztsʼą́ąʼgo dah náázhdiikai, nítʼééʼ jóʼakon, haʼaʼaahdi sǫʼ dajiiłtsánígíí halą́ąjįʼ nihináánádzáago ashkii áłtsʼíísí sitínígíí bikáaʼgi niiltłah.

en: When they saw the star they shouted joyfully.
nv: sǫʼ dajiiłtsą́ągo tʼáá íiyisí bąą hoł dahóózhǫǫd,

en: then they went into the house and saw the child with his mother Mary, then bowing down they worshipped Jesus, also having opened their treasure boxes, they gave to him gold and frankincense and myrrh.
nv: áko kin góneʼ yah ajookai nítʼééʼ ashkii áłtsʼíísígíí bimá mary tʼáá bił dajiiłtsą́, áko jesus bichʼįʼ nitsidazdeezgoʼgo bichʼįʼ nidahodzisá, índa hanaalyeʼé daʼílíinii ąą ádajiilaago, óola áádóó tsin bijeeh łikání halchinii fránkinsens índa mir wolyéii baa dajiiznil.

en: And being warned in a dream to not return to Herod, they returned back into their own country.
nv: áádóó naʼiigeełgo hérad baa nínáánóhkááh lágo hoʼdooʼniidgo, nákʼeeʼąągo hakéyahgóó aníjookai.

en: Then after they had gone, so then, and angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph and said, “Get up, with the boy and his mother flee to Egypt. Remain there until I tell you, because Herod is going to look for the child to kill him.”
nv: áko dah nízhdiikaigo, jóʼakon, jóseph nayiiyeełgo bóhólníihii bidiyingo naalʼaʼí bichʼįʼ yitʼíní íʼdiilyaago ábidííniid, nídiidááh, áádóó ashkii áłtsʼíísígíí bimá bił tsʼídá tsxį́įłgo ííjipgóó dohkááh. nił náhweeshʼneʼjįʼ áadi nihighan doo, háálá hérad éí ashkii yidiyoołhééł biniyé háidínéeztą́ą́ʼ.

en: Then he got up with the child and his mother during the night and went to Egypt.
nv: áko nízhdiiʼnaʼgo ashkii áłtsʼíísígíí áádóó bimá ałdóʼ bił tʼáá tłʼééʼ ííjipgóó ajookai.

en: There residing until Herod died. Then, I called my son out of Egypt, what was spoken by the prophet was fulfilled.
nv: áadi kééhojitʼį́įgo hérad yę́ę daaztsą́. áko, shiyeʼ ííjipdę́ę́ʼ wóshdę́ę́ʼ chʼínínááh bidííniid, níigo bóhólníihii éí diyin god yá halneʼii biniitʼaa yee haadzíiʼii bohoolyaa.

en: When Herod saw that he had been tricked by the wise men he became enraged. Then in Bethlehem and the surrounding area he sent men to kill all boys two in age and under, according to the time he had learned from the wise men about the star.
nv: nítʼééʼ hérad éí hastóí dahóyáanii bindaʼazloʼgo nákʼeeʼąągo anáákaígíí bił bééhoozingo tʼáá íiyisí yikʼee ádá hoolchįįd. áko béthlehemgi índa binaagóó ashiiké naaki béédááhaidóó yaagoígíí yichʼįʼ iʼiisʼaʼgo ałtso nidabiʼdiztseed, éí hastóí dahóyáanii sǫʼ yaa chʼídahazʼánígíí bikʼehgo ákóhóótʼįįd.

en: What was spoken by the prophet Jeremiah was fullfilled:
nv: éí diyin god yá halneʼii jeremáíyah kóníigo yee haadzííʼ yę́ę bohoolyaa:

en: “In Ramah a voice was heard, weeping and loud wailing, Rachel crying for her children, and she did not want to be comforted, for the children were gone.”
nv: réímahgi iinééʼ diistsʼą́ą́ʼ, yínííł yee chanahałeʼgo áádóó yichago índa ayóó átʼéego atíńdindleeh, réíchel baʼáłchíní náás ahoolchíiłii yaa yicha, haʼíídóolniiłígíí doo yinízin da, háálá áłchíní yę́ę ábiʼdisdįįd.

en: After Herod had died, so then, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt
nv: nidi hérad daaztsą́ą́dóó bikʼijįʼ, jóʼakon, ííjipgi jóseph nayiiyeełgo bóhólníhii bidiyingo naalʼaʼí bichʼįʼ yitʼíní íʼdiilyaago

en: he said to him, “Get up, take the child and his mother to the land of Israel, for those seeking the child died.”
nv: ábíłní, nídiidááh, ashkii áádóó bimá ałdóʼ bił ízrel bikéyahgóó nihéénóhkááh, háálá ashkii yidaʼniiłhį́ yę́ę daneezná.

en: Then he got up and took the child and his mother and returned to the land of Israel.
nv: áko nízhdiiʼnaʼgo tʼáá áko ashkii índa bimá ałdóʼ bił dashdiikaigo ízrel bikéyahgóó níjíkai.

en: When he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there, then after being warned in a dream, he went to the land of Galilee.
nv: nítʼééʼ judíyagi arkiléíyas éí bizhéʼé hérad yę́ę bitsáskʼehgi naatʼáanii nilį́įgo jííniiʼgo biniinaa ákǫ́ǫ́ nízhdooʼnéłígíí béédzísdzííd, áko baa nináájiisgeelgo honááʼílniiʼgo gálilii kéyahgóó jiníná.

en: The prophets, he will be called a Nazarene, that which they had spoken was fulfilled when they resided in the town of Nazareth.
nv: diyin god yá dahalneʼii, názariin deiłníi dooleeł, daaní yę́ę bohodoolnííł biniyé názareth kin haalʼáagi jinínáago ákwii kééhojitʼį́.

en: In those days John the Baptist came into the wilderness of Judea proclaiming,
nv: ákwii yoołkááł yę́ędą́ą́ʼ john tó yee asį́įhii, judíya kéyah honoojíidi níyáago halneʼgo kóní,

en: “Repent to God, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”
nv: łahgo átʼéego diyin god bichʼįʼ tsíńdahidohkeesgo ádił nidaʼiyohsíihii bitsʼáhóhkááh, háálá yáʼąąshii bee bóhólníihgo bił hazʼáanii bílátah dahashzhiizh.

en: Indeed John, he is the one about whom Isaiah the prophet had spoken saying: “In the wilderness the voice of one shouting, Prepare the way for the Lord, make his paths straight.”
nv: john lą́ą, éí aizéíyah diyin god yá halneʼii nilíinii haa yáłtiʼgo ání: honoojíidi łaʼ chánahgo kójíníigo hwiinééʼ diitsʼaʼgo hojilneʼ: bóhólníihii bá honítʼiʼii hashtʼe dahohłééh, beʼatiin kʼéhézdongo ádaahłééh.

en: John wore clothing made from camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist, and his diet consisted of locusts and wild honey.
nv: john éí ghą́ą́ʼaskʼidii bighaaʼ bee ééʼ ályaago haʼééʼ, áádóó akał sis bee áká dzíszaaz, índa nahachagiitsoh índa tsésʼná bitłʼizh ałdóʼ hachʼiyąʼ.

en: Then people from Jerusalem and all over Judea and all the region around the Jordan River were going out to him.
nv: nítʼééʼ jerúsalemdę́ę́ʼ áádóó judíyadę́ę́ʼ tʼáá níłtéél nítʼééʼ índa jórdan tooh binaadę́ę́ʼ tʼáá átʼéé nítʼééʼ diné haa haaskai.

en: He was baptizing them in the Jordan River as they confessed their sins.
nv: bibąąhági ádaatʼéii yee ádaa dahoolneʼgo jórdan tooh nílínígíí biyiʼ tó bee dadzíísį́į́ʼ.

en: But when he saw many Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism he said to them, “you offspring of vipers! Who warned you to flee from God’s coming wrath?”
nv: nidi férisii áádóó sádjusii danilíinii tó bee dabidiʼdoolzįh biniyé deíkáahgo jiiłtsą́ągo ábijiní, tłʼiish baʼáłchíní danohłíinii! háishąʼ diyin god tʼóó báhádzidgo bibee atéʼélʼíinii bitsʼą́ąjįʼ dah dadínóohchééh nihidííniid?

en: Therefore produce fruit that proves your repentance,
nv: éí bąą łahgo átʼéego diyin god bichʼįʼ tsíńdadohkeesgo beełtʼéego nihitsʼą́ą́dóó aneestʼąʼ dahóleʼ,

en: and don’t think you can say to yourselves, We have Abraham as our father, for I tell you that God can raise up children for Abraham from these stones.
nv: áádóó tʼóó ádaa dadzíínóhdlíigo tʼáá nihiyiʼídi, éíbraham yeeʼ nihizhéʼé nilį́, tʼáadoo dadohníní, háálá ánihidishní, diyin god díí tsé kǫ́ǫ́ naaznilígíí bee éíbraham baʼáłchíní íidoolíiłgo yíneelʼą́.

en: Even now at the root of the trees the ax is laid, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
nv: kʼad nidi tsin bihétłʼóól biniyé tsénił siʼą́, áko tsin tʼáá ałtso bineestʼąʼ doo yáʼátʼééhgóó bąąh nídahadleehígíí kʼídahalneʼgo, kǫʼ biyiʼ góneʼ adahaltłʼiid.

en: For repentance I baptize you with water, but the one coming after me is more powerful than I am, then I am not worthy to carry his sandals; he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
nv: łahgo átʼéego diyin god bichʼįʼ tsíńdahidohkeesgo bąąhági ádanohtʼé yę́ę bitsʼáhóhkáahgo tó bee danihisį́į́h, nidi shikéédę́ę́ʼ náájoodáłígíí éí shiláahgo ájítʼé, áko hakeeʼ yish łéeł dooígíí doo bą́ą́h nishłį́į da; hó tʼéí níłchʼi diyinii índa kǫʼ bee danihidzisį́įh doo.

en: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will clean out his threshing floor and will gather his wheat into the storehouse, but the chaff he will burn up with inextinguishable fire.
nv: hó éí ásaaʼ bee ąąh oolchʼíhígíí dah jooʼááł, áádóó hááʼjílkʼáahgi hozhdidooshǫǫłgo hatłʼoh naadą́ą́ʼ nooh níjílchíihgi yah ahizhdooyééł, nidi azhool tʼéí kǫʼ doo nitséesii bee adizhdoołkʼą́ą́ł.

en: Then Jesus came up to the Jordon from Galilee, to John to be baptized by him.
nv: ákohgo gáliliidę́ę́ʼ jórdanjįʼ jesus níyá, john tó yee hodoosįh biniyé.

en: But John tried to prevent him saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and yet you come to me?”
nv: nidi john éí jesus chʼééh kóbizhdííniid, nigo yeeʼ tó bee shidíísįh nítʼééʼ, daʼ ákoósh jó nida tó bee nideesįh biniyé shéíníyá?

en: But Jesus replied to him, “Let it happen now, for it is right for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then John yielded to him.
nv: nidi jesus ánááhodooʼniidgo ání, bíniʼdii kʼad éí ákótʼé, háálá ákótʼéego tʼáá ákogi ádaatʼéii tʼáá ałtso biʼdiilnííł. áko john yee lą́ asłį́į́ʼ.

en: And Jesus just as he was coming up out of the water, the heavens opened, and he saw the Holy Spirit of God descending like a dove and coming on him.
nv: áádóó jesus tó bee hoʼdoolzį́įʼgo táyiʼdę́ę́ʼ háádzísdzá, nítʼééʼ jóʼakon yáʼąąsh ąą ádzaa, áádóó diyin god biníłchʼi diyinii hasbídí nahalingo jesus bikʼijįʼ hadahooleełgo áádóó bikʼi dah neezdáago jiiłtsą́.

en: And a voice from heaven said, “This is my one dear Son, in him I take great delight.”
nv: áádóó yáʼąąshdę́ę́ʼ iinééʼ diistsʼą́ąʼgo ání, díí shiyeʼ ayóóʼóóshʼníinii jílį́, tʼáá íiyisí hąą shił hózhǫ́.

en: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
nv: nítʼééʼ níłchʼi bidaʼiiníziinii binanitʼaʼí jesus nayídínóotah biniyé jesus éí níłchʼi diyinii honoojíígóó abíísá.

en: Then he fasted forty days and forty nights he was famished.
nv: áko tʼáadoo ajiyání dízdiin jį́ índa dízdiin tłʼééʼ azlį́į́ʼdóó bikʼijįʼ índa dichin dzizlį́į́ʼ.

en: Then here the tempter having arrived said to him, “If you are the Son of God command these stones to become bread.”
nv: áko naʼ íńtaahii haa níyáago áháłní, diyin god biyeʼ nílį́į́ ládą́ą́ʼ díí kǫ́ǫ́ tsé naaznilígíí bááh nídadoodleełgo bá handziih.

en: Jesus answered this, “It is written in God’s word: ‘Man does not live by bread alone, but only by every word that comes from the mouth of God.’”
nv: jesus haadzíiʼgo ání, diyin god bizaad bee akʼeʼashchíinii kóní: diné doo bááh tʼéí yee hináa da doo, nidi saad tʼáá ałtso  diyin god yee hahadziihii yee hináadoo.

en: Then the devil took him to the holy city standing him on the highest point of the temple,
nv: áko níłchʼi bidaʼiiníziinii binanitʼaʼí éí diyingo kin haalʼáágóó hoł níʼáazhgo áadi kin biiʼ sohodizin bikááʼdóó dego yaaʼáhígíí bílátahgi dah hwiisįʼgo,

en: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God throw yourself down, because it is written: ‘God will command his angels concerning you’, ‘with their hands they will lift you up so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.’”
nv: ánááhodiʼní, diyin god biyeʼ nílį́į́ ládą́ą́ʼ kodóó hadah dah diilyeed, háálá kótʼéego bee akʼeʼashchį́: diyin god éí bidiyingo nidaalʼaʼí naa ádahalyą́ągo íidoolííł, bílaʼ yee dah daníłteehgo doo tsé bikʼą́ą́h didííltałda.

en: And Jesus said to the devil, “So, in God’s word it is written also saying: ‘You are not to put the Lord your God to the test.’”
nv: áádóó jesus éí níłchʼi bidaʼiiníziinii binanitʼaʼí ánéidooʼniid, jó, diyin god bizaad bee akʼeʼashchíinii ałdóʼ ání, bóhólníihii nihidiyin god tʼááká nabínóótaah lágo.

en: Again the devil took him to a very high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their grandeur,
nv: nááʼáłdóʼ níłchʼi bidaʼiiníziinii binanitʼaʼí dził aghánáhóóʼáajįʼ hoł hanáánáshtʼáazhgo, nahasdzáán bikáaʼgi bee ídahólníihgo bił nahazʼáanii áádóó yee ayóó ádaatʼéii tʼáá ałtso hoł yitʼíní áyiilaa,

en: And he said to him, “I will give you all these things if you throw yourself to the ground and worship me.”
nv: áádóó áháłní, shichʼįʼ nitsidíínígoʼgo áádóó shichʼįʼ nahosínísáago díí tʼáá ałtso naa dideeshʼááł.

en: Then Jesus said again to him, “Go away, Satan! For in God’s word it is written: ‘You are to worship the Lord your God, and serve only him.’”
nv: nítʼééʼ jesus ánáádíʼní, yówehdi naniná, séítan! háálá diyin god bizaad bee akʼeʼashchíinii ání: bóhólníihii nidiyin god bichʼįʼ nahółáa doo, áádóó tʼáá bí tʼéiyá bá nanilʼaʼ doo.

en: Then the devil left him. And angels came and began ministering to his needs.
nv: ákohgo índa níłchʼi bidaʼiiníziinii binanitʼaʼí hakʼi deeyáago dahodiileʼ. áádóó jóʼakon diyingo nidaalʼaʼí haa haaskaigo há chodaozʼįįd.

en: Now when Jesus heard that John had been imprisoned, he went into Galilee.
nv: jesus éí john yah abiʼdooltʼeʼígíí jííniiʼgo gálilii kéyah góneʼ ajííyá,

en: Then he moved from Nazareth into the region of Zebulun and Naphtali in Capernaum by the sea to make his home.
nv: áko názarethdóó dashdiiyáago zébyulan áádóó náftalai kéyah biyiʼ kapérniyam hoolyéhígi beʼekʼid bąąhgóó kééhojitʼį́į́ nítʼééʼ.

en: What was spoken by the prophet Isaiah would be fulfilled:
nv: diyin god yá halneʼii aizéíyah kóníigo yee haadzíiʼii bohodoolnííł biniyé áadi kééhojitʼį́į́ nítʼééʼ:

en: “Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali,
nv: zébyulan kéyah áádóó náftalai kéyah, tooh jórdan bilááhdóó, beʼekʼid bichʼįʼgo gálilii kéyahgi, doo jew dineʼé danilíinii kéédahatʼį́.
beyond the jordan, galilee by the sea, the gentiles reside –	matt 4:15

en: the people who sit in darkness have seen a great light, and on those who sit in the region and shadow of death a light has dawned.”
nv: diné éí chahałheeł yiiʼ kéédahatʼį́į́ nítʼéʼígíí ayóó átʼéego adinídíingo dayiiłtsą́, áádóó anoonééł nahazʼą́ą́góó índa bichahaʼohgóó nidaháaztą́ą́ nítʼéʼígíí bił chʼídaʼdeezdláád.

en: From that time Jesus began to preach this message: “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”
nv: éí hoolzhish yę́ędóó wóshdę́ę́ʼ jesus ahoʼniilneʼgo ání, łahgo átʼéego diyin god bichʼįʼ tsíńdahidohkeesgo ádił nidaʼiyohsíihii bitsʼáhóhkááh, háálá yáʼąąshii bee bóhólníihgo bił hazʼáanii bílátah dahashzhiizh.

en: As he was walking by the Sea of Galilee, he saw the brothers, Simon (called Peter), and his brother Andrew, casting a fishing net into the sea (for they were fishermen).
nv: áko gálilii beʼekʼid bąąhgóó joogááł, nítʼééʼ diné tʼáá łaʼ hááʼáazhgo, łaʼ sáíman éí peter wolyéhígíí, áádóó bitsilí andrew, łóóʼ bee hahaltsósí taah yiłtsóosgo jiiłtsą́, háálá éí łóóʼ hayiileehí nilį́.

en: And he said to them, “Let’s go, follow me, and I will turn you into fishers of people.”
nv: áádóó ábizhdííniid, tįʼ, shikééʼ wohʼash, áko łóóʼ hayiileehí nahalingo diné náhółbįįhgo ánihideeshłííł.

en: They left their nets immediately and followed him.
nv: tʼáá áko hałóóʼ bee hahaltsósí tʼáá ákǫ́ǫ́ nizhnínilgo bikééʼ dashdiiʼáázh.

en: And going on from there he saw some other brothers, James and his brother John, in a boat with Zebedee their father mending their fishing nets, and he called them.
nv: áádóó dah náázdiidzáago zébedii biyeʼké tʼáá łaʼ hááʼáazhii nilį́įgo, éí james áádóó bitsilí john, bizhéʼé zébedii tsinaaʼeeł biyiʼ yił naháaztą́ągo łóóʼ bee hadahaltsósí hashtʼéédeidleʼgo jiiłtsą́, áádóó hágo bizhdííniid.

en: They immediately left the boat and their father, and they followed Jesus.
nv: tʼáá áko tsinaaʼeeł tʼáá ákǫ́ǫgo hazhéʼé bitsʼą́ą́ʼ dashdiiʼáázh, áádóó jesus bikééʼ jiníʼáázh.

en: Throughout all of Galilee Jesus went teaching in their synagogues, he preached the gospel of the kingdom, and he healed all kinds of disease and sickness among the people.
nv: gálilii kéyahgóó tʼáá níłtéél nítʼééʼ kéédahatʼínígíí bikin yiiʼ áłah nídaadleehí naaznilgóó jesus nazhʼnitingo, áádóó aláahgo bee óhólníihgo bił hazʼáanii baa haneʼ yáʼátʼéehii baa hojilneʼ, índa diné bitahgóó naałniih bąąh dahólóonii tʼáá ałtso áádóó ka nidaaką́gíí tʼáá ałtso hadaałtʼé ándajidleʼgo tázhdííyá.

en: Then a report about him spread throughout Syria, and people brought to him all who suffered with various illnesses and afflictions and those who had seizures, paralytics, and those possessed by demons, and he healed them.
nv: áko síriya kéyah biyiʼgóó tʼáá átʼéé nítʼééʼ bee haa haʼniihígíí dadideezdláád, áádóó ka nidaaką́gíí tʼáá ałtso tʼáá daʼníłʼąą ádaatʼéego bąąh dah nahazʼánígíí áádóó dadiniihígíí índa níłchʼi biʼiiníziinii biyiʼ dahólónígíí, áádóó tsiʼnídadikahígíí índa bitah doo nidahwiiʼnánígíí haa dayiizhjaaʼgo hadaałtʼé áńdajiidlaa.

en: And from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and beyond the Jordan River large crowds followed him.
nv: áko gálilii kéyahdę́ę́ʼ índa diikápolisdę́ę́ʼ áádóó jerúsalemdę́ę́ʼ áádóó judíyadę́ę́ʼ índa jórdan tooh wónaanídę́ę́ʼ diné nidahaaskaigo tʼóó ahayóí hakééʼ naanánooyééł.

en: When he saw the crowds, he went up the mountain, while he was sitting there his disciples came to him.
nv: áko jesus éí diné tʼóó ahayóí jiiłtsą́ągo dził bíjiiyá, áadi dasneezdáago hódahoołʼaahii haa yíkai.

en: Then he began to teach them by saying:
nv: áko hadzoodzíiʼgo kójíníigo nazʼneeztą́ą́ʼ:

en: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to them.
nv: diyin kʼehgo hojoobaʼ ádaatʼéego ádaa nitsídaakeesii bikʼidahojidlí, háálá yáʼąąshii bee bóhólníihgo bił hazʼáanii daabííʼ.

en: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
nv: yínííł nidaakaígíí bikʼidahojidlí, háálá hadaʼíídóolniił.

en: Blessed are the gentle, for they will inherit the earth.
nv: aʼohgo ádaʼdólzinii bikʼidahojidlí, háálá éí nahasdzáán daabííʼ dooleeł.

en: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be satisfied.
nv: tsʼídá tʼáá ákogi éʼétʼéii yíká dichin áádóó dibááʼ danilíinii bikʼidahojidlí, háálá éí yee hwiih dadooleeł.

en: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.
nv: aa aʼááh danízinii bikʼidahojidlí, háálá éí baa aʼááh dahwiidínóodzįįł.

en: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
nv: aʼátʼeʼ doo bijéí biiʼ dahólóonii bikʼidahojidlí, háálá diyin god dayooʼį́į doo.

en: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called the children of God.
nv: kʼé nídahoołeełii bikʼidahojidlí, háálá diyin god baʼáłchíní dabidiʼníi doo.

en: Blessed are those who are persecuted for righteousness, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to them.
nv: tsʼídá tʼáá ákogi éʼétʼéii biniinaa atídabiʼdilʼíinii bikʼidahojidlí, háálá yáʼąąshii bee bóhólníihgo bił hazʼáanii daabííʼ.

en: Blessed are you when people insult you and persecute you and say all kinds of evil things about you falsely on account of me.
nv: shiniinaa diné danihódziihgo índa atídanihiłʼį́įgo índa woochʼííd badaaʼihii tʼáá ałtso yee nihaa nidahalneʼgo nihikʼidahojidlí.

en: Rejoice and be glad because your reward is great in heaven, for they persecuted the prophets before you in the same way.
nv: tʼáá íiyisí baa nihił dahózhǫ́ǫgo nihił dahózhǫ́, háálá yáʼąąshdi ayóó átʼéii nihaa dahidoolyééł, háálá tʼáá ákótʼéego diyin god yá dahalneʼii yę́ę tʼáá nihítséedi atídayííłʼįįd.

en: You are the salt of the earth. But if salt loses its flavor, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything except to be thrown out and trampled on by people.
nv: nihokááʼ dineʼé bá áshįįh danohłį́, nidi áshįįh doo halniih da yileehgoshąʼ haa yitʼéego halniih áńdoolnííł? jó, doo halniih da yileehgo tʼóó yóóʼiilkaʼgo bikʼi naʼaldeeh yileeh.

en: You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill cannot be hidden.
nv: nihí nihokááʼ dineʼé bá adinídíín danohłį́. jó, wókʼą́ągi kin haalʼáago niiʼniłígíí doo nanóolʼį́į́ʼ átʼée da łeh.

en: So, people do not light a lamp and put it under a basket but on a lampstand, and it gives light to all in the house.
nv: jó, diné éí bee hoolʼiní yidiiłtłiʼgo doo tsitsʼaaʼ yił yaa niidooʼáał da, nidi bá yaʼiiʼáhígi dah yiʼáahgo kin biyiʼ góneʼ nidzíiztánígíí tʼáá ádzíłtso há bee niʼdeezdíin łeh.

en: In the same way, let your light shine before people, so that they can see your good deeds and give honor to your Father in heaven.
nv: tʼáá ákótʼéego diné binááł dadííʼnółdíín, áko yáʼátʼéehgo ádaahníłígíí nihá dayooʼį́įgo, nihitaaʼ yáʼąąshdi hólóonii yaa dahaniih dooleeł.

en: Do not think that Jesus has come to abolish the law of Moses or the prophets. I have not come to abolish these things, but I came to fulfill them.
nv: jesus éí bee hazʼáanii mózes baa deetʼáanii yeinítʼį́ bee hazʼáanii mózes baa deetʼáanii áádóó diyin god yá dahalneʼii bizaad ázhdoołdįįł biniyé jiníyá tʼáadoo dashíínóhʼníní; nahjįʼ kódeeshłííł doo biniyé níyáa da, nidi biʼdeeshłííł biniyé níyá.

en: I tell you the truth, until heaven and earth pass away not the smallest letter or stroke of a letter will pass from the law until everything takes place.
nv: háálá tʼáá aaníí ánihidishní, yádiłhił índa nahasdzáán bił yóóʼahóóyáajįʼ tʼááłáhígo dah alzhin áádóó tʼááłáhígo adeesdzo nidi bee hazʼáanii bitsʼą́ą́dóó doo bił yóóʼahodoogáał da, nidi ałtso bohoolyaago índa.

en: Therefore anyone who breaks one of the least of these commands of God and teaches others to do so will be called least in the kingdom of heaven, but whoever obeys them and teaches others to do so will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
nv: éí bąągo tʼáá háiida díí diyin god yee hasʼáanii áłtsʼíísígíí łaʼ doo ílį́į́góó ájiilaago, tʼáá éí bee diné nazhnitinígíí yáʼąąshii bee bóhólníihgo bił hazʼą́ądi tsʼídá aʼohgo ájítʼé hodiʼníi doo, nidi tʼáá háiida yeʼełʼį́įgo yee naʼnitinígíí éí yáʼąąshii bee bóhólníihgo bił hazʼą́ądi ayóó ájítʼé hodiʼníi doo.

en: For I tell you, unless your righteousness goes beyond that of the experts in the law and the Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
nv: háálá ánihidishní, bee hazʼáanii yíndaʼniłtinii áádóó férisii danilíinii biláahgo tsʼídá tʼáá ákogi ádanohtʼéego tʼéiyá yáʼąąshii bee bóhólníihgo bił hazʼáanii biih hidoohkah.

en: Jesus said that you have heard that it was said to an older generation, “Do not murder,” and “whoever murders will be subjected to judgment.”
nv: jesus áháchįʼ yeinítʼį́ ałkʼidą́ą́ʼ diné kódabidiʼníí nítʼéeʼgo dasidootsʼą́ą́ʼ, diné tsʼídá doo diyííłhéeł da, áko tʼáá háiida diné adziisxínígíí haa náhódóotʼįįłii bą́ą́h jílį́į doo.

en: But I say to you, anyone who is angry with a brother will be subjected to judgment, and whoever insults a brother will be brought before the council, and whoever says “You are a fool” will be sent to fiery hell.
nv: nidi shí ánihidishní, tʼáá háiida łaʼ hakʼis bichʼįʼ háhóóchįįdígíí bee haa náhódóotʼįįłii bą́ą́h jílį́į doo, áádóó tʼáá háiida hakʼis yáábíʼjiiʼįįdígíí naatʼáanii danilíinii yee aa nídaatʼíinii bą́ą́h jílį́į doo, índa tʼáá háiida hakʼis nilíinii, diigis nílį́, bizhdííniidígíí biniinaa hoolʼáágóó kǫʼ biiʼ tiʼhooʼnííh bą́ą́h jílį́į doo.

en: So if you bring your gift to the altar, and there remember that your brother has something against you,
nv: éí bąą bikááʼ nááʼiiniihí bikááʼdóó nááʼayíłniihgo, nítʼééʼ nikʼis bíniʼ yiniłʼaʼ yę́ę béénílniiʼgo,

en: leave your gift there in front of the altar, and first go and be reconciled to your brother, and then come and present your gift.
nv: tʼáá ákwii nááhidííłnihígíí bikááʼ nááʼiiniihí bíighahgi nidíílééł, áádóó nikʼis áłtsé bichʼįʼ nídíídáałgo bił kʼé náʼahididííʼ niił, áko índa nídíídáałgo náádiʼyííłnih.

en: Reach agreement quickly with your accuser while on the way to court, or he may hand you over to the judge, and the judge hand you over to the warden, and you will be thrown into prison.
nv: diné nikʼíháʼáhígíí aa hwiinítʼį́į́góó bił yíʼashgo tsxį́įłgo bił kʼé náʼahididííʼniił, doodaiiʼ ánihwiiʼaahii yaa nididooʼááł, áádóó ánihwiiʼaahii yah iʼiiníiłii yaa nididooʼááł, índa yah andiʼdooltʼeeł.

en: I tell you the truth, you will never get out of there until you have paid the last penny!
nv: tʼáá aaníí ánihidishní, tsʼídá doo chʼéenidiʼdooltʼeeł da, sindáo tʼáá nidziihígi ákʼéninéínídláago índa chʼéenidiʼdooltʼeeł.

en: You have heard that it was said, “Do not commit adultery.”
nv: tsʼídá doo azhdilée da, haʼníí nítʼéeʼgo dasidootsʼą́ą́ʼ.

en: But I say to you, whoever looks at a woman to desire her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
nv: nidi shí ánihidishní, tʼááłáʼí jinítínígo asdzání bidázhnoolníigo jinééłʼį́ʼígíí tʼáá íídą́ą́ʼ hajéí biiʼ bił ahizhdoolyáago átʼé.

en: If your right eye causes you to sin, tear it out and throw it away! It is better to lose one of your members than to have your whole body thrown into hell.
nv: áko ninááʼ nishʼnáájí bąąhági ánítʼį́ ánóhsingo haniʼaahgo yóóʼahíłhan, háálá nitsʼíís łahgo ádinjí doo ná yáʼátʼéeh da, nidi nitsʼíís hadaałtʼéego hoolʼáágóó tiʼhooʼnííh bił hazʼą́ąjįʼ andiʼyoolghą́ą́łjí agháago doo ná yáʼátʼéeh da.

en: And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away, because it is better to lose one of your members than to have your whole body go into hell.
nv: áádóó nílaʼ nishʼnáájíígíí bąąhági ánítʼį́ ánóhsingo éí kʼínígéeshgo yóóʼahíłhan, háálá nitsʼíís łahgo ádinjí doo ná yáʼátʼéeh da, nidi nitsʼíís hadaałtʼéego hoolʼáágóó tiʼhooʼnííh bił hazʼą́ąjįʼ andiʼyoolghą́ą́łjí agháago doo ná yáʼátʼéeh da.

en: It was said, “Whoever divorces his wife must give her a legal document.”
nv: tʼáá háiida hweʼasdzą́ą́ yóóʼazhdiʼaahgo naaltsoos bikʼehgo ałtsʼáʼdootʼashígíí hadilyaago baazdoołtsos ałdóʼ haʼníí nítʼééʼ.

en: But I say to you, everyone who divorces his wife except for immorality, makes her commit adultery, and whoever marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
nv: nidi shí ánihidishní, tʼáá háiida hweʼasdzą́ą́ doo adilée da nidi tʼóó yóóʼazhdííʼánígíí éí asdzání adidooléełgo bee bá hojiiłʼaʼgo átʼé, áádóó asdzání yóóʼabiʼdootʼánígíí łaʼda bá nááʼásgehgo éí diné adíílá.

en: For Jesus continued, you have heard that it was said to an older generation, “Do not break an oath, but fulfill your vows to the Lord.”
nv: jesus ádee haʼdiidziih yeinítʼį́ nááʼáłdóʼ ałkʼidą́ą́ʼ diné kódabidiʼníí nítʼéeʼgo dasidootsʼą́ą́ʼ, tʼáadoo tʼóó ádíníigo ádee hahídziihí, nidi bee ádee hahídziihii éí bóhólníihii binááł biʼdíílííł.

en: But I say to you, do not take oaths at all – not by heaven, because it is the throne of God,
nv: nidi shí ánihidishní, tsʼídá tʼáadoo haʼátʼíhída bee ádee hahídziihí, yáʼąąsh bee nidi dooda, háálá éí bikááʼdóó diyin god nahaʼá,

en: and not by earth, because it is his footstool, and not by Jerusalem, because it is the city of the great King.
nv: áádóó nahasdzáán bee nidi dooda, háálá éí bibikʼi dah adéesʼeezí átʼé, índa jerúsalem bee nidi dooda, háálá éí aláahgo naatʼáanii ayóó átʼéii bikin yílʼáhígíí átʼé.

en: and also do not take an oath by your head, because you are not able to make one hair white or black.
nv: áádóó ałdóʼ tʼáadoo nitsiitsʼiin bee ádee hahídziihí, háálá nitsiiʼ tʼááłáʼí nidi łigaigo éí doodago łizhingo ádíílíłígíí doo bíninilʼą́ą da.

en: Let your word be “Yes” or “No”; more than this is from the evil one.
nv: tʼáadoo átʼéhígóó, aooʼ, doodaiiʼ, dooda, dadohní; díidí biláahjįʼ haʼiidziihígíí éí bąąhági átʼéii bitsʼą́ą́dóó átʼé.

en: “An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth,” you have heard that it was said.
nv: hanááʼ atíyiilaago bidiníná binááʼ atínízhdoodlííł, índa hawooʼ atíyiilaago biwooʼ atínízhdoodlííł, haʼníí nítʼéeʼgo dasidootsʼą́ą́ʼ.

en: But I say to you, do not resist the evildoer. But whoever strikes you on the right cheek, turn the other to him as well.
nv: nidi shí ánihidishní, diné doo ákǫ́ǫ́ ánihiłʼínígíí doo kʼéédidoohdlíił da. nidi łaʼda niniitsįʼ nishʼnáájíígíí néidííłtsʼingo, łahjígo bee bichʼįʼ dah náádidíníítʼááł.

en: And if someone wants to sue you and to take your tunic, give him your coat also.
nv: diné łaʼda niʼéétsoh biniinaa naaltsoos nee niiníłtsoozgo, bíniʼdii nibeeldléí ałdóʼ yoołtsos doo.

en: If anyone forces you to go one mile, go with him two.
nv: łaʼda yíniniłchéehgo, tʼááłáʼí tsin sitą́ąjįʼ shił niníʼaash, niłníigo, ákondi naakidi tsin sitą́ąjįʼ bił nidííʼash.

en: Give to the one who asks you, and do not reject the one who wants to borrow from you.
nv: tʼáá háiida tʼáadoo leʼé níyókeedígíí baa díílééł, áádóó tʼáá háiida, tʼáadoo leʼé shaʼnílé, niłníigo tʼááká dooda bidóoneʼlágo.

en: “Love your neighbor,” but “hate your enemy,” you have heard that it was said.
nv: bił kééhótʼíinii ayóóʼííníʼní, nidi niʼanaʼí éí jiiníłá, haʼ níí nítʼéeʼgo dasidootsʼą́ą́ʼ.

en: But I say to you, love your enemy, and pray for those who persecute you,
nv: nidi shí ánihidishní, nihiʼanaʼí ayóóʼádeínóhʼní, áádóó tʼáá bitaʼígi ádanihiłʼíinii] áádóó atídanihiłʼíinii bá sodadołzin,

en: so that you may be like your Father in heaven, since he causes the sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.
nv: áko nihitaaʼ yáʼąąshdi hólóonii baʼáłchíní danohłį́į doo, háálá doo yáʼátʼééh ádaaníiłii índa yáʼátʼééh ádaaníiłii bá hááʼátʼáahgo áyósin, áádóó tʼáá ákogi ádaaníiłii índa doo tʼáá ákogi ádaaníiłii bá nááháltį́įhgo áyósin.

en: So, if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Even the tax collectors do the same, don’t they?
nv: jó, ayóóʼádanihóʼníinii tʼéí ayóóʼádeínóhʼníigo, haʼátʼíísh bikʼé nihaa doolyééł? tax nahalyéhígíí yiniyé naazdáii nidi ákódaatʼį́. tʼáásh aaníí?

en: And if you only greet your brothers, what more do you do? Even the Gentiles do the same, don’t they?
nv: nihikʼisóó danilíinii tʼéiyá kʼé dabidohníigo náádaałaʼígíishąʼ haʼátʼíí bee bilááh ádanohtʼé? doo jew dineʼé danilíinii nidi ákódaatʼį́. tʼáásh aaníí?

en: As your heavenly Father is perfect, you also be perfect.
nv: éí bąągo nihitaaʼ yáʼąąshdi hólóonii tsʼídá tʼáá ákóneʼ átʼéhígi átʼéego, nihí ałdóʼ tsʼídá tʼáá ákóneʼ ádanohtʼée leʼ.

en: Be careful not to display your righteousness merely to be seen by people. Otherwise you have no reward with your Father in heaven.
nv: tʼóó diné yee danihiníłʼį́į doo biniyé diné binááł joobaʼ bee ádaahníłígíí bitsʼąą ádaa ádahołyą́; ákódaahtʼį́įgo nihitaaʼ yáʼąąshdi hólóonii nihaidooléełii ádin doo.

en: Thus whenever you do charitable giving do not blow a trumpet before you. The hypocrites do that in synagogues and on streets so that people will praise them. I tell you the truth, they have their reward.
nv: éí bąą hojoobaʼ ádaatʼéii bíká ánánílwoʼgo diné tʼóó áhodilʼíinii ádaatʼínígi átʼéego dilní tʼáadoo ádílą́ąjįʼ diniłtsʼaʼí. éí kin biiʼ áłah nídaʼadleehgóó índa kintaa aztiingóó diné tʼóó baa dahaniih doo biniyé ádaatʼį́. tʼáá aaníígóó ánihidishní, éí hachʼįʼ nidadoolyéełii tʼáá íídą́ą́ʼ hwee dahazlį́į́ʼ.

en: But when you do your giving, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
nv: nidi nílaʼ nishʼnáájí bee hojoobaʼ ádaatʼéii bíká anánílwoʼgo nílaʼ nishtłʼajíígíí éí tʼáadoo bił bééhóziní íínísin.

en: Then your gift may be in secret. And your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.
nv: áko áká anánílwoʼgo tʼáadoo yiʼniihí baa naniná, áko nitaaʼ tʼáadoo yiʼniihí ááníiłii yooʼíinii, éí naʼdoolééł.

en: And whenever you pray, do not be like the hypocrites, because they love to pray while standing in synagogues and on street corners so that people can see them. Truly I say to you, they have their reward.
nv: áádóó diné tʼóó ádahodilʼį́įgo sodadilzinígi átʼéego tʼáadoo sodílziní, háálá éí diné danihiníłʼį́į doo, danízingo kin biiʼ áłah nídaʼadleehgóó índa kintahgi naańdaʼaztiingóó naazį́įgo sodadilzingo bił dahoneełni. tʼáá aaníí ánihidishní, éí hachʼįʼ nidadoolyéełii tʼáá íídą́ą́ʼ hwee dahazlį́į́ʼ.

en: But whenever you pray, go into your room, close the door, and pray to your Father in secret. And your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.
nv: nidi sodílzingo doo naagháhí góneʼ yah anáńdáahgo ádáńdílkałgo nitaaʼ doo yitʼį́į́góó hólóonii bichʼįʼ sodílzin, áko nitaaʼ tʼáadoo yiʼniihí ááníiłii yooʼíinii, éí naʼdoolééł.

en: And when you pray, do not babble repetitiously like the Gentiles, because they think that by their many words they will be heard.
nv: áádóó sodadołzingo, doo jew dineʼé danilíinii ádaatʼínígi átʼéego saad tʼáadoo biniyéhí daígíí tʼáadoo háádahołtʼéhí, háálá ákótʼéego saad ląʼí bee haasdzíiʼgo shá dazdidootsʼį́į́ł danízin.

en: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask him.
nv: éí bąągo tʼáadoo éigi ádanohtʼéhí, háálá bídin danohłį́įgo chodaołʼínígíí nihitaaʼ bídeínóhkeed dooígíí tʼáá íídą́ą́ʼ bił bééhózin.

en: So pray this way:
nv: kótʼéego sodadołzin: nihitaaʼ yáʼąąshdi honílóonii, nízhiʼ diyingo óolzin leʼ,
our father in heaven, may your name be honored,	matt 6:9

en: May your kingdom come. And may your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
nv: bee nóhólníihii náásgóó kʼeeʼąą yilzhish leʼ. áádóó bee íinínízinii tʼáá yáʼąąshdi ááníłígi átʼéego nahasdzáán bikáaʼgi ááníił,leʼ.

en: Give us today our daily bread.
nv: chʼiyáán tʼáá ákwíí jį́ nihaʼiyíłtsódígíí díí jį́ nihaa náádiníʼaah.

en: And forgive us our sins, as we ourselves have forgiven those who sin toward us.
nv: áádóó tʼáá nihichʼįʼ bąąhági ádaaníiłii bá yóóʼadahidiitʼaahígi átʼéego nichʼįʼ nidaʼayiilzíhígíí nihá yóóʼahidíʼaah.

en: And do not lead us into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. [Amen.]
nv: áádóó nihí hodínóotahjįʼ nihiʼóółnííh lágo, nidi bąąhági átʼéii bitsʼą́ąjįʼ yisdánihiyínííł. [tʼáá ákótʼée doo.]

en: For if you forgive others their sins, your heavenly Father will also forgive you,
nv: háálá diné nihichʼįʼ doo ákǫ́ǫ́ ádáátʼįįdii bá yóóʼadahidohʼaahgo nihitaaʼ yáʼąąshdi hólóonii bichʼįʼ doo ákǫ́ǫ́ ádaotʼįįdii ałdóʼ nihá yóóʼiidiiʼaah doo,

en: but if you do not forgive others, your Father will not forgive you your sins.
nv: nidi diné nihichʼįʼ doo ákǫ́ǫ́ ádáátʼįįdii doo bá yóóʼadahidohʼaahgóogo, nihitaaʼ bichʼįʼ doo ákǫ́ǫ́ ádaotʼįįdii ałdóʼ doo nihá yóóʼiididooʼáał da.

en: When you fast, do not look sullen like the hypocrites, for they make their faces unattractive so that people will see them fasting. I tell you the truth, they have their reward.
nv: hodílzingo doo adą́ baa naahkaigo diné tʼóó ádahodilʼį́įgo yínííł yił nidaakaígi átʼéego tʼáadoo ákódanohtʼéhí, éí biniiʼjįʼ haaʼí lá doo ádayoołʼįįł da, hodílzingo doo adą́ yaa naakaígíí éí tʼóó diné yee danihiníłʼį́ danízingo ádaatʼį́. tʼáá aaníí ánihidishní, éí bichʼįʼ nidadoolyéełii tʼáá íídą́ą́ʼ bee dahólǫ́.

en: But when you fast, put oil on your head and wash your face,
nv: nidi hodílzingo doo adą́ baa nanináago nitsiiʼ náníłtłah áádóó niniiʼ tánínánígis,

en: so that it will not be obvious to others when you are fasting, but only to your Father who is in secret, and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.
nv: áko hodílzingo doo adą́ baa nanináhígíí diné doo ná dayooʼį́į da doo, nitaaʼ doo yitʼį́į́góó hólóonii tʼéiyá ná yooʼį́į doo, áádóó nitaaʼ tʼáadoo yiʼniihí ááníiłii yooʼíinii, éí naʼdoolééł.

en: Do not accumulate for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy and where thieves break in and steal,
nv: nahasdzáán bikáaʼgi chʼosh ałchozhii hólǫ́ǫgi, áádóó tʼáadoo leʼé nídahidiniichxíihgi, índa aniʼįįhii kin yighá daʼanilgo daʼniʼįįhgi, nihinaalyeʼé daʼílíinii tʼáadoo ádá hashtʼeʼ nidahidohʼníłí,

en: but accumulate for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moth and rust do not destroy, and thieves do not break in and steal.
nv: nidi yáʼąąshdi chʼosh ałchozhii ádindi, áádóó tʼáadoo leʼé doo nídahidiniichxíihgi, índa aniʼįįhii doo kin yighá daʼanilgo daʼniʼįįhdi, nihinaalyeʼé ádá hashtʼeʼ nidahidohʼnííł.

en: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
nv: háálá nihinaalyeʼé siláadi tʼáá ákwii ałdóʼ nihijéí hólǫ́ǫ doo.

en: The eye is the lamp of the body. If then your eye is healthy, your whole body will be full of light,
nv: bee hoolʼiní bee adinídínígi átʼéego anááʼ bee atsʼíís bá adinídíín. éí bąą ninááʼ yáʼátʼéehgo nitsʼíís tʼáá átʼé bił hoolʼin doo,

en: but if your eye is diseased, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
nv: nidi ninááʼ doo yáʼátʼééhgóó nitsʼíís tʼáá átʼé bił chahałheeł doo. áko éí bąągo niyiʼdi adinídíín dooleeł yę́ę éí tʼáá átʼé chahałheeł nilį́įgo dooládóʼ chahałheeł da doo!

en: No person can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and money.
nv: diné łaʼda doo tʼáá łahjįʼ naatʼáanii naaki bá nijólʼaʼ átʼée da, háálá łaʼ bikʼeezhdiniih doo, łaʼ éí ayóóʼájóʼníi doo, éí doodaléiʼ łaʼ doo nahdi jóʼníi da doo, łaʼ éí jijoołáa doo. diyin god índa atʼį́ doo tʼáá łahjįʼ bá nijólʼaʼ átʼée da.

en: Therefore I tell you, what will I eat? Or, what will I drink? Or, what about my body? What you will wear. Isn’t there more to life than food and more to the body than clothing?
nv: éí bąą ánihidishní, haʼátʼíí lá deeshį́į́ł lá? doodaiiʼ, haʼátʼíí lá deeshdlį́į́ł lá? doodaiiʼ, haʼátʼíí lá bee hadideeshnííł lá? tʼáadoo danohsingo bee dahinohnáa dooleełígíí bíká ádił nídahodoł chiłí. jiinánígíí éísh chʼiyáán doo biláahgo ílį́į da, áádóó hatsʼíísísh ééʼ doo biláahgo ílį́į da?

en: Look at the birds in the sky: They do not sow, or reap, or gather into barns, yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you more valuable than they are?
nv: tsídii wódahgo nidaatʼaʼígíí danółʼį́: éí doo kʼéédaʼdidléeh da, doo nidi nídaʼagish da, índa doo nooh nídaʼałchíih da, ákondi nihitaaʼ yáʼąąshdi hólóonii baʼałtsoʼ. daʼ nihíísh doo éí biláahgo daʼnohłį́į da?

en: And which of you by worrying can add even one hour to his life?
nv: áádóó nihí łaʼ ádił náhodołchiłgo hinohnánígíí tʼįįhdígoósh bilááh ádoohłíiłgo bínoołʼą́?

en: Why do you worry about clothing? Think about how the flowers of the field grow; they do not work or spin,
nv: áko haʼátʼíísh biniyé nihiʼééʼ bíká ádił nídahodołchił? nihokááʼgóó chʼilátah hózhóón nidaniseʼígíí baa nitsídaahkees, éí doo nidaalnish da, índa doo daʼadiz da,

en: yet I tell you, that not even Solomon in all his glory was clothed like one of these!
nv: nidi ánihidishní, azhą́ sálaman ayóó ájítʼéé nítʼééʼ nidi, doo łaʼ díí hadadítʼéhígi átʼéego hazhdítʼée da nítʼééʼ.

en: And if this is how God clothes the wild grass, which is here today and tomorrow is tossed into the fire to heat the oven, won’t he clothe you even more, you people of little faith?
nv: éí lá bąą diyin god nihokááʼgóó chʼilígíí díí jį́ nidaniseʼgo, áádóó yiską́ągo konkʼeh góneʼ ahidoolkałígíí nidi nizhónígo haidósingo, tʼįįhdígo daʼiinohdláanii, daʼ ákoósh éidíígíí biláahgo doo hadadinohtʼéego ánihósin da?

en: So then, don’t worry saying, “What will we eat?” Or, “What will we drink?” Or, “What will we wear?”
nv: éí bąą, haʼátʼíí lá dadiidį́į́ł lá? doodaiiʼ, haʼátʼíí lá dadiidlį́į́ł lá? doodaiiʼ, haʼátʼíí lá bee hadadiniitʼée dooleeł lá? tʼáadoo dadohníigo ádił nídahodołchiłí.

en: For the unconverted pursue these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.
nv: háálá doo jew dineʼé danilíinii éidí tʼáá ałtso hádaatʼį́; jó nidi, nihitaaʼ yáʼąąshdi hólóonii díidí tʼáá ałtso bídin danohłį́įgo chodaołʼínígíí nihá bił bééhózin.

en: But above all pursue his kingdom and righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.
nv: nidi diyin god bee bóhólníihgo bił hazʼáanii áádóó yee tsʼídá tʼáá ákogi átʼéii alą́ąjįʼ hádaahtʼį́, áko éidí tʼáá ałtso nihá bíidoolyééł.

en: So then do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.
nv: éí bąą yiską́ągo áhootʼée dooleełígíí tʼáadoo bíká ádił nídahodołchiłí, háálá yiską́ągo bíká ádił nídahodichiłii dahólǫ́ǫ doo. łaʼa jį́ biiʼ achʼįʼ nahwiiʼ ná nihwiileehígíí bíniʼdii tʼáá ákódígo achʼįʼ nahwiiʼná hólǫ́.

en: Do not judge so that you will not be judged.
nv: doo nihaa nídahódóotʼįįłígíí biniyé tʼáadoo aa nídaahtʼíní.

en: For by the standard you judge you will be judged, and the measure you use will be the measure you receive.
nv: háálá bee aa nídaahtʼíinii tʼáá éí bikʼehgo nihaa nídahódóotʼįįł, áádóó tʼáá łaʼ bá ídaʼnoołʼąąd yę́ęgi ánéeltʼeʼgo nihá ínídadíʼnóolʼąął.

en: Why do you see the speck in your brother’s eye, but fail to see the beam of wood in your own?
nv: áko haʼátʼíí biniyé nikʼis binákʼe ooltsʼidígíí níníłʼį́, nidi tʼáá ni nástáán ninákʼee sitánígíísh doo baa ákonínízin da?

en: Or how can you say to your brother, “Let me remove the speck from your eye,” while there is a beam in your own?
nv: éí doodaiiʼ tʼáá ni nástáán ninákʼee sitą́ągo, haʼátʼéego nikʼis ábididííniił, haaʼíshąʼ ninákʼe ooltsʼidígíí ná haashʼaah?

en: You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
nv: tʼóó áhodilʼíní nílíinii, áłtsé nástáán ninákʼee sitánígíí hanitįįh, áko índa hazhóʼó ííníʼį́įgo nikʼis binákʼe ooltsʼidígíí bá hadííʼááł.

en: Do not give what is holy to dogs, and do not throw your pearls before pigs. otherwise they will trample them under their feet and turn around and tear you to pieces.
nv: haʼátʼíhída dílzinii tʼáadoo łééchąąʼí bichʼįʼ adahołtłʼiidí, áádóó nihidiichiłí tʼáadoo bisóodi bichʼįʼ adahołkaadí. ákódaahtʼį́įgo éí yikʼi nidookah áádóó tʼáá yiláahjįʼ nihichʼįʼ dah didoojahgo danihidooʼał.

en: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened for you.
nv: daʼíínóhkeed, áko dę́nóhkeedígíí nihaa dadoolyééł; hádaahtʼį́, áko hádaahtʼínígíí bikʼídadoohkah; dáádílkał nídanołtsʼin, áko nihá ąą ádadoolnííł.

en: For everyone who asks receives, and the one who seeks finds, and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened.
nv: háálá tʼááłáʼí jinítínígo dajókeedii éí haa dahalyé, hádajitʼínígíí bikʼídajiikááh, índa dáádílkał nídazniłtsʼinígíí há ąą ádaalneʼ.

en: Is there anyone among you who, if his son asks for bread will give him a stone?
nv: nihitahdóó diné łaʼ biyeʼ łeesʼáán bíyííkeedgo daʼ tséésh yeidooʼááł?

en: Or if he asks for a fish will give him a snake?
nv: éí doodago łóóʼ bíyííkeedgo daʼ tłʼiishísh yeidoołtééł?

en: If you then, although you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good gifts to those who ask him!
nv: áko nihí doo yáʼádanohtʼéeh da nidi, aa doolyéełii yáʼádaatʼéehii nihadaʼáłchíní baa dadoohłéełii nihił béédahózingo, éí bilááh átʼéego nihitaaʼ yáʼ ąąshdi hólóonii haʼátʼíhída yáʼádaatʼéehii bídajókeedígíí haa yiiníiłgo átʼé.

en: In everything, treat others as you would want them to treat you, for this fulfills the law of and the prophets.
nv: éí bąą diné hachʼįʼ ádaaníił leʼ danohsinígi átʼéego nihígo yeeʼ bichʼįʼ ákódaahníił leʼ, háálá éí bee hazʼáanii áádóó diyin god yá dahalneʼii yee nidaʼnitin.

en: Enter through the narrow gate, because the gate is wide and the way is spacious that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter through it.
nv: áhoołtsʼóózígo yah ahóótʼiʼí góneʼ yah ahohkááh, háálá atíʼoolníiłjįʼ hóteelgo yah ahóótʼiʼ áádóó hóteelgo bichʼįʼ honítʼiʼ, áko diné ląʼí ákóneʼ yah ahikááh.

en: But the gate is narrow and the way is difficult that leads to life, and there are few who find it.
nv: háálá iináajįʼ áhoołtsʼóózígo yah ahóótʼiʼ áádóó áhoołtsʼóózígo bichʼįʼ honítʼiʼ, áko tʼáá díkwíí éí yikʼídahakááh.

en: Watch out for false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing but inwardly are voracious wolves.
nv: tʼóó ádahodilʼį́įgo dahalneʼii bitsʼąą ádaa ádahołyą́, jó éí dibégi átʼéego doo báhádzidgóó nihaa nídaakah, nidi dabiyiʼdi tʼéí mąʼiitsoh tʼóó báhádzidgo dichin daazlį́įʼgo daʼaldeełii nidahalin.

en: You will recognize them by their fruit. Grapes are not gathered from thorns or figs from thistles, are they?
nv: nidi éí tsin bineestʼąʼ bee bééhózinígi átʼéego ádaaníłígíí bee nihił béédahózin doo. daʼ chʼil deeníníísh bąąhdóó chʼil naʼatłʼoʼii wóbé, éí doodaiiʼ, daʼ hoshísh bąąhdóó fig wolyéhígíí wóbé?

en: So, in the same way, every good tree bears good fruit, but the bad tree bears bad fruit.
nv: jó, tsin yáʼádaatʼéehii tʼáá ałtso bąąhdóó aneestʼąʼ yáʼátʼéehii nídahoodleeł, nidi tsin nichxǫ́ʼígíí bąąhdóó aneestʼąʼ nichxǫ́ʼígíí náhoodleeł.

en: A good tree is not able to bear bad fruit, nor a bad tree to bear good fruit.
nv: tsin yáʼátʼéehii bąąhdóó aneestʼąʼ nichxǫ́ʼígíí doo hóleʼ átʼée da, áádóó tsin nichxǫ́ʼígíí bąąhdóó aneestʼąʼ yáʼátʼéehii doo hóleʼ átʼée da.

en: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
nv: tsin tʼáá ałtso bineestʼąʼ doo yáʼátʼééhgóó bąąh nídahadleehígíí kʼídahalneʼgo kǫʼ biyiʼ góneʼ adahaltłʼiid.

en: So then, you will recognize them by their fruit.
nv: áko tsin bineestʼąʼ bee bééhózinígi átʼéego tʼóó ádahodilʼį́įgo dahalneʼii ádaaníłígíí bee nihił béédahózin doo.

en: Not everyone who says to me, “Lord, Lord,” will enter into the kingdom of heaven – only the one who does the will of my Father in heaven.
nv: tʼááłáʼí jinítínígo, bóhólníihii, bóhólníihii, dashijinínígíí doo tʼáá ádzíłtso yáʼąąshii bee bóhólníihgo bił hazʼáanii biih dahizhdookah da, nidi tʼáá háiida shitaaʼ yáʼąąshdi hólóonii íinízinii bikʼeh ájítʼéhígíí tʼéiyá.

en: On that day, many will say to me, “Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, and in your name cast out demons and do many powerful deeds?”
nv: éí bijį́įdi ląʼí ádashididooniił, bóhólníihii, bóhólníihii, daʼ nízhiʼísh bee doo diyin god bá nidahosiilneʼ da, daʼ nízhiʼísh bee doo níłchʼi bidaʼiiníziinii ayiʼdę́ę́ʼ hadahineelkaad da, áádóó daʼ dǫ́sh ádahooníiłii ayóó ádaatʼéii ląʼí nízhiʼ bee baa nidasiikai da?

en: Then I will declare to them, “I never knew you. Go away from me, you lawbreakers!”
nv: ákondi ádabidideeshniił, tsʼídá doo nihééhasin da; bąąhági átʼéii baa dę́nóhkáahii, shitsʼánóhkááh.

en: Everyone who hears these words of mine and does them is like a wise man who built his house on rock.
nv: áko tʼááłáʼí jinítínígo díí shizaad dazdiitsʼaʼgo bidaʼjiłʼínígíí éí diné léiʼ hóyą́ągo tséʼéłkáaʼgi bikin niiníʼánígíí nidahojílin,

en: The rain fell, the flood came, and the winds beat against that house, but it did not collapse because it had been founded on rock.
nv: áko nahóółtą́ índa tó dááląąd, áádóó ayóó átʼéego éí kin bichʼįʼ deeyol, nidi tʼáadoo ahiih náázhoozh da, háálá tséʼéłkáaʼgi niitʼą́.

en: Everyone who hears these words of mine and does not do them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.
nv: áádóó tʼááłáʼí jinítínígo díí shizaad dazdiitsʼaʼgo doo bidaʼjiłʼínígíí, éí diné léiʼ doo hóyą́ą́góó séítahgi bikin niiníʼánígíí nidahojílin.

en: The rain fell, the flood came, and the winds beat against that house, and it collapsed; it was utterly destroyed!”
nv: áko nahóółtą́ índa tó dááląąd, áádóó ayóó átʼéego éí kin bichʼįʼ deeyolgo ahiih náázhoozh. dooládóʼ ahiih náʼííłdáaz da!

en: When Jesus finished saying these things, the crowds were amazed by his teaching,
nv: ákohgo jesus díí saad ałtso bee hadzoodzíiʼgo diné yílʼáhígíí hanaʼnitin bikʼee tʼóó bił adahóóyóí,

en: because he taught them like one who had authority, not like their experts in the law.
nv: háálá naatʼáanii ídlį́įgo naʼnitinígíigi átʼéego nazʼneeztą́ą́ʼ, bee hazʼáanii yíndaʼniłtinii nahalingo éí dooda.

en: I Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother write this letter.
nv: shí paul, diyin god íinízinígíí bee jesus christ bá deeshʼaałgo shíká ádííniidii, áádóó sástheniiz nihikʼis nilínígíí bił naaltsoos íilnééh.

en: To the church of God that is in Corinth, to those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, and called to be saints, with all those in every place who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours we write this letter:
nv: kórinthgi diyin god dayoodláanii áłah nádleehii christ jesus bee diyingo ádabiʼdiilyaii, diyin god bidiyį́į́ʼ dadooleełgo bíká ádahodooʼniidii, áádóó tʼáá ałtsogóó bí áádóó nihí nihibóhólníihii jesus christ bízhiʼ bee sodadiilzinígíí tʼáá ałtso ałdóʼ bichʼįʼ naaltsoos íilnééh:

en: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
nv: diyin god nihitaaʼ áádóó bóhólníihii jesus christ bibee ajoobaʼ índa bibee achʼįʼ hózhǫ́ náhásdlį́įʼii yee nihikʼijidlíi doo.

en: I always thank my God for you because of the grace of God that was given to you in Christ Jesus.
nv: diyin god bibee ajoobaʼ éí christ jesus bee nihikʼihojidlíhígíí bąą tʼáá áłahjįʼ diyin god bichʼįʼ nihaa ahééh nisin.

en: For you were made rich in every way in him, in all your speech and in every kind of knowledge.
nv: tʼáá bí bee tʼáá ałtsojįʼ saad tʼáá ałtso índa ił ééhózin tʼáá ałtso bee dasoohtʼįįd.

en: Just as the testimony about Christ has been confirmed among you,
nv: christ baa haneʼ tʼáá aaníí deisoohdląądii bikʼehgo dahinohná,

en: so that you do not lack any spiritual gift as you wait for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ.
nv: áko nihibóhólníihii jesus christ yitʼíní ánáádiʼdoolníłígíí bibaʼ ádanohtʼéego níłchʼi diyinii bitsʼą́ą́dóó aa yílyáii tʼáá ałtso yee nihikʼijidlí.

en: He will also strengthen you to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
nv: áádóó tʼáá nihonítʼiʼjįʼ danołdzilgo ánihijósin doo, áko nihibóhólníihii jesus christ beiníłką́ądi tʼáadoo bee nihikʼídahótʼahígóó nihéédahodoozįįł.

en: God is faithful, by whom you were called into fellowship with his son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
nv: diyin god baʼahódlíii biyeʼ jesus christ nihibóhólníihii bił ahił danohdlį́į doo biniyé nihíká ádííniid.

en: My brethren, I urge you by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to agree together, to end your divisions, and to be united by the same mind and purpose.
nv: shikʼisóó, tʼáá ánółtso tʼáadoo ałghadadohtʼáhí, áádóó tʼáadoo ałtsʼáhkahí, nidi tʼááłáʼí góneʼ nitsáhákeesgo áádóó tʼááłáʼí hootʼááł bee daʼahíínóhtąʼ doogo nihibóhólníihii jesus christ bízhiʼ binahjįʼ baa nánihooshkąąh.

en: For, my brethren, members of Chloe’s household have made it clear to me, that there are quarrels among you.
nv: háálá, shikʼisóó, łaʼ klówii bighandóó shił dahalneʼgo, łaʼ saad ahídaatʼááh danihiłní.

en: Now I mean this: that each of you is saying, “I am with Paul,” or “I am with Apollos,” or “I am with Cephas,” or “I am with Christ.”
nv: ááhdishníinii éí díí: nihí łaʼ, shí paul yíhoołʼaahii nishłį́, dadohní. áádóó łaʼ éí, shí tʼéí apálas yíhoołʼaahii nishłį́. náánáłaʼ éí, shí tʼéí peter yíhoołʼaahii nishłį́. náánáłaʼ éí, shí tʼéí christ yíhoołʼaahii nishłį́, dadohníí lá.

en: Is Christ divided? Of course not! Paul wasn’t crucified for you, was he? Or were you in fact baptized in the name of Paul? Of course not!
nv: christ daatsʼí ałtsʼááʼnil? dooda lą́ą! daʼ tsin ałnáoszid bąąhjįʼísh paul nihá bił oʼoolkaal? paul bízhiʼ daatsʼí binahjįʼ tó bee danihiʼdoolzį́į́ʼ? dooda lą́ą!

en: I thank God that I did not baptize any of you, except Crispus and Gaius,
nv: diyin god bichʼįʼ ahééh nisin, nihitahgi doo łaʼda tó bee yísį́įʼ da, nidi kríspas índa géíyas tʼéiyá tó bee yísį́į́ʼ.

en: so that no one can say that you were baptized in my name!
nv: áko, paul bízhiʼ binahjįʼ tó yee dayíísį́į́ʼ, doo jidóneʼ átʼée da.

en: (I also baptized the household of Stephanus. Otherwise, I do not remember whether I baptized anyone else.)
nv: (stéfanas bighandóóígíí ałdóʼ tó bee dę́sį́į́ʼ. áádóó doo łaʼda tó bee hóósį́ʼí da nisin.)

en: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel. And not with clever speech, so that the cross of Christ would not become useless.
nv: háálá tó bee asįįh dooleeł biniyé christ doo shiníłʼaʼ da, nidi haneʼ yáʼátʼéehii baa hashneʼ doo biniyé. saad naachʼąąhígíí doo bee hashneʼ da, háálá saad naachʼąąhii bee hashneʼgo éí tsin ałnáoszid yąąhjįʼ christ daaztsą́ągo baa hashneʼígíí doo idééłníi da doo.

en: For the message about the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
nv: háálá tsin ałnáoszid bąąhjįʼ christ daaztsą́ągo baa haneʼígíí éí diné doo yisdánáhaaskaii haneʼ tʼáá ádzaą́ átʼé danízin. nidi yisdánihiʼdiisʼnilígíí éí diyin god bibee adziilii átʼé daniidzin.

en: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and I will thwart the cleverness of the intelligent.”
nv: jó, diyin god bizaad bee akʼeʼashchíinii ání, dahóyą́ dabidóʼníinii éí doo dahóyą́ą́góó ádadeeshłííł, áádóó nidahazyąądii éí bibee hódząʼ tʼáadoo nánídlínígóó ádeeshłííł.

en: Where is the wise man? Where is the expert in the law? Where is the debater of this age? Has God not made the wisdom of the world foolish?
nv: diné hóyą́ dabidóʼníiniishąʼ? bee hazʼáanii yínaʼniłtinii dabidóʼníiniishąʼ? díí hoogáłígíí biyiʼ aghadaʼditʼáahiishąʼ? diyin god éí nihokááʼ dineʼé bibee hódzáanii doo áháyą́ átʼéego ííshjání áyiilaa.

en: For since in the wisdom of God the world by its wisdom did not know God, so, God was pleased to save those who believe by the foolishness of preaching.
nv: háálá nihokááʼ dineʼé habee hódzáanii bee diyin god tsʼídá doo bééhozdoosįįł da, jó, haneʼ yáʼátʼéehii éí tʼáá ádzaą́ átʼé daznízin nidi, baa dahwiilneʼii dayoosdląądii yisdéidiyooniłgo diyin god hóyą́ągo yinahazʼą́.

en: For Jews demand miraculous signs, and Greeks ask for wisdom.
nv: háálá jew dineʼé danilíinii éí diyin god bibee adziilii bee bééhózinii nihá ádoolnííł daaníigo dayókeed, áádóó gríik dineʼé danilíinii éí bee hódzáanii tʼéí bił ayóó ádaatʼé.

en: But we preach about a crucified Christ, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles.
nv: nidi nihí éí tsin ałnáoszid bąąhjįʼ christ bił oʼoolkaalígíí baa dahwiilneʼ. éí jew dineʼé dabidínóołtłʼahii átʼé, áádóó gríik dineʼé danilíinii haneʼ bee bił dahwiilneʼígíí éí haneʼ tʼáá ádzaą́ átʼé danízin,

en: But to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God.
nv: nidi jew dineʼé índa gríik dineʼé danilíinii bitahgóó diyin god bíká ádííniidii christ éí diyin god bibee adziilii áádóó bibee hódzáanii átʼé danízin.

en: For the foolishness of God is wiser than human wisdom, and the weakness of God is stronger than human strength.
nv: háálá diyin god doo hóyą́ą da ílį́į nidi, nihokááʼ dineʼé yiláahdi hóyą́, áádóó diyin god doo bidziil da ílį́į nidi, nihokááʼ dineʼé yiláahdi ábóodziil.

en: My brethren, think about the circumstances of your call, brothers and sisters. Not many were wise by human standards, not many were powerful, not many were born to a privileged position.
nv: shikʼisóó, diyin god nihíká ádííniidígíí baa nitsídaahkees. jó, doo ląʼí nihokááʼ dineʼé kʼehgo dahonohsą́ą da, doo ląʼí ayóó átʼéii danohłį́į da, doo ląʼí diné ílíinii danohłį́į da, ákondi diyin god nihíká ádííniid.

en: But God chose what the world thinks foolish to shame the wise, and God chose what the world thinks weak to shame the strong.
nv: nidi nihokáaʼgi tʼóó bá nidahatʼiʼii diyin god nábiilááh, nihokááʼ dineʼé dahóyáanii tʼóó ádaa yádadínóodzįįł biniyé, áádóó doo dabidziilígíí ałdóʼ náyiilááh, éí ayóó ádaatʼéii tʼóó ádaa yádadínóodzįįł biniyé.

en: God chose what is low and despised in the world, what is regarded as nothing, to set aside what is regarded as something.
nv: nihokááʼ dineʼé dabijoołáii índa doo dandzinii índa doo bił daʼóltaʼii diyin god náyiilááh, áko éí bee haʼátʼíhída tʼáá ákónéehee ádaatʼéii átʼéego baa nitsáhákeesii tʼáadoo nánídlínígóó bee bééhodoozįįł.

en: So that no one can boast in God’s presence.
nv: áko diyin god binááł nihokááʼ dineʼé doo łaʼ ádaa hojóʼniih átʼée da doo.

en: But, he is the reason you have a relationship with Christ Jesus, who became for us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification and redemption.
nv: nidi diyin god éí christ jesus bił łáʼí nohłį́įgo ánihiilaa, tʼáá éí bee ałdóʼ dahoniidzą́ągo, tsʼídá tʼáá ákogi ádaniitʼéego, dadiniigingo, índa bąąhági átʼéii bitsʼą́ąjįʼ náábiʼdiizniiʼii daniidlį́įgo diyin god ánihiilaa.

en: So that, as it is written, “Let the one who boasts, boast in the Lord.”
nv: áko diyin god bizaad bee akʼeʼashchíinii ánínígi átʼéego, tʼáá háiida tʼáadoo leʼé baa hashniih jinízinii, éí hániʼdii bóhólníihii áátʼįįdii baa hojiniih doo.

en: My brethren, when I came to you, I did not come with superior eloquence or wisdom as I proclaimed the testimony of God.
nv: shikʼisóó, diyin god yee naʼnitinii bee nihił hodeeshnihgo nihaa níyáádą́ą́ʼ saad naachʼąąhii índa saad bee hódzáanii doo bee yáshtiʼgo nihaa níyáa da.

en: For I decided to be concerned about nothing among you except Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
nv: háálá nihitahgóó naasháago jesus christ áádóó tʼáá éí tsin ałnáoszid bąąhjįʼ bił oʼoolkaalígíí tʼéiyá baa yáshtiʼ doo niizį́į́ʼ.

en: And I was with you in weakness and in fear and with much trembling.
nv: nihitaasháádą́ą́ʼ doo shidziil da nítʼééʼ, índa shił yéeʼgo shitah hoditłid nítʼééʼ,

en: My conversation and my preaching were not with persuasive words of wisdom, but with a demonstration of the Spirit and of power.
nv: hódzą́ saad ayóó ánóolninii doo bee yáshtiʼ da nítʼééʼ, nidi níłchʼi diyinii binaanish áádóó bibee adziilii ííshjání áshłéehgo hashneʼ nítʼééʼ.

en: So that your faith would not be based on human wisdom but on the power of God.
nv: áko diyin god bibee adziilii bikʼehgo daʼiinohdlą́, diné bibee hódzáanii bikʼehgo éí dooda.

en: Now we do speak wisdom among the mature, but not a wisdom of this age or of the rulers of this age, who are perishing.
nv: nidi hweʼoodląʼ bee nidahizneesáanii tʼéiyá saad bee hódzáanii bee nidahonishtin. nidi doo díí nihokáaʼgi hódzą́ągo bee hootʼáałii átʼée da; díí hoolzhishígíí biiʼ nidazhnitʼáii nidi doo há bee hódzáanii átʼée da, háálá éí ázhdoodįįł.

en: Instead we speak the wisdom of God, hidden in a mystery, that God determined before the ages for our glory.
nv: nidi diyin god bibee hódzáanii doo bééhózin da yę́ę, diné bitsʼąą nanilʼin yę́ę, kʼad baa hashneʼ, éí hódzáanii diyin god yee ayóó átʼéii bił ałtsʼą́ą́ʼ daʼniilkʼiiz doo biniyé tʼah doo hahalzhíísh yę́ędą́ą́ʼ tʼáá bí yinahazʼą́.

en: None of the rulers of this age understood the wisdom of God. If they had known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
nv: diyin god bibee hódzáanii díí hoolzhishígíí biyiʼ naatʼáanii danilíinii doo łaʼ bił bééhózin da nítʼééʼ. bił béédahózingo bóhólníihii ayóó átʼéii doo tsin ałnáoszid bąąhjįʼ yił adaʼaskaal da doo nítʼééʼ.

en: But just as it is written, “Things that no eye has seen, or ear heard, or mind imagined, are the things God has prepared for those who love him.”
nv: nidi diyin god bizaad bee akʼeʼashchíinii ánínígi átʼéego: diné tsʼídá doo łaʼ hazhdeelʼįįhii, doo nidi baa hozdiitsʼį́įhii, łáʼí nidi doo baa nitsídzíkeesii, éí diyin god ayóóʼádabóʼníinii yá hashtʼeyiilaa.

en: God has revealed these to us by the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.
nv: nidi nihí éí diyin god biníłchʼi diyinii bee nihił bééhózingo áyiilaa. háálá níłchʼi diyinii tʼáá ałtsoní neiłkaah, diyin god yinahazʼáanii doo bééhózin da yę́ę nidi bił bééhózin.

en: For who among men knows the things of a man except the man’s spirit within him? So too, no one knows the things of God except the Spirit of God.
nv: háálá diné ła'da náánáłahjį' diné bintsíkees doo hoł bééhózin da, diné bii' sizíinii t'áá bí yee nitsíkeesígíí t'éiyá bił bééhózin łeh. t'áá ákót'éego diyin god bintsíkees doo ła'da hoł bééhózin da, nidi t'áá hazhó'ó diyin god biníłch'i diyinii t'éiyá bił bééhózin.

en: Now we have not received the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, so that we may know the things that are freely given to us by God.
nv: doo da'oodlání nitsídaakeesígi át'éego doo nitsídeiikees da, nidi diyin god yee nihik'ijisdli'ígíí baa ákodadíníidzįįł biniyé t'áá bí níłch'i diyinii nihainíł'a'.

en: And we speak about these things, not with words taught us by human wisdom, but with those taught by the Spirit, explaining spiritual things to spiritual people.
nv: áko nihokáá' dine'é bibee hódzáanii doo bee na'niitin da, nidi níłch'i diyinii yínanihiniłtinígíí bee na'nitin, diyin k'ehgo ádaat'éii níłch'i diyinii bik'ehgo bína'niiltin.

en: The unbeliever does not receive the things of the Spirit of God, for they are foolishness to him. And he cannot understand them, because they are spiritually discerned.
nv: nidi níłch'i diyinii doo hwii' hólóonii éí diyin god biníłch'i diyinii yee ak'ijidlíii doo hwee haleeh da. éí t'áá ádzaaí át'é jinízin, áko doo hoł bééhoozį́į́' át'ée da, háálá éí níłch'i diyinii k'ehgo ak'izhdiitą́ągo t'éiyá t'áá yíní át'éii hoł bééhodoozįįł.

en: The one who is spiritual discerns all things, yet he himself is understood by no one.
nv: níłch'i diyinii hwii' hólóonii éí t'áá ałtsoní hazhó'ó nijiłkaah, nidi hó t'éí doo ła'da hwéidoołkah da.

en: For who has known the mind of the Lord, so as to advise him? But we have the mind of Christ.
nv: háishą' bóhólníihii bintsíkees hoł bééhózingo, nidízhnóotįįłgo bízhneel'ą́? nidi nihí éí christ bintsíkees bee nitsídeiikees.

en: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our dear friend and colaborer,
nv: paul, christ jesus baa hashneʼgo biniinaa awáalyaą́ nishłíinii, áádóó timothy nihikʼis nilíinii, failííman ayóóʼííníiʼníigo bił nideiilnishígíí,

en: to Apphia our sister, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church that meets in your house we write this letter:
nv: áádóó áfiya nihilah, áádóó arkípas bił siláo daniidlínígíí áádóó nighangi daʼoodlání áłah nádleehígíí bichʼįʼ naaltsoos íilnééh:

en: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
nv: diyin god nihitaaʼ áádóó bóhólníihii jesus christ bibee ajoobaʼ áádóó bibee achʼįʼ hózhǫ́ náhásdlį́įʼii yee nihikʼijidlíi leʼ.

en: I always thank my God as I remember you in my prayers.
nv: tʼáá áłahjįʼ shisodizin bee nénáshniihgo shidiyin god bichʼįʼ ahééh nisin.

en: Because I hear of your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints.
nv: háálá bóhólníihii jesus índa diyin god bidiyį́į́ʼ danilíinii tʼáá ałtso ayóóʼííníʼníigo áádóó baa dzíínílíigo naa hodiistsʼaʼ.

en: I pray that the faith you share with us may deepen your understanding of every blessing that belongs to you in Christ.
nv: áko christ bitsʼą́ą́dóó yáʼádaatʼéehii tʼáá yíní átʼéegi bee akʼiʼdiitįįh binahjįʼ neʼoodląʼ idééłníi doo biniyé sodiszin.

en: My friend, I have had great joy and encouragement because of your love, for the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you.
nv: shikʼis nílíinii, ayóóʼíʼííníʼnínígíí tʼáá íiyisí baa nihił hóózhǫǫd, áádóó bee haʼiisisniʼ, háálá diyin god bidiyį́į́ʼ ninahjįʼ bijéí bikʼéédahóótaad.

en: Although I have quite a lot of confidence in Christ and could command you to do what is proper,
nv: ákótʼé bąą christ biniitʼaa tʼáá íiyisí doo sistiʼgóó kódíínííł nidideeshniił daatsʼí,

en: But I Paul, an old man and even now a prisoner for the sake of Christ Jesus, would rather appeal to you on the basis of love.
nv: nidi shí paul, hastóí nishłį́įgo áádóó kʼad jesus christ baa hashneʼgo biniinaa awáalyaą́ nishłį́įgo ayóóʼánóshʼníigo nánooshkąąhjígo shił yáʼátʼééh.

en: I am appealing to you concerning Onesimus, my child in Christ, whose spiritual father I have become during my imprisonment.
nv: onésimas, christ bee shiyeʼ nilíinii, bá nánooshkąąh, éí awáalyaadi sédáago oodlání kʼehgo bizhéʼé sélį́į́ʼ.

en: Who was formerly useless to you, but is now useful to you and me.
nv: éí tʼah nahą́ądę́ę́ʼ doo ná chooʼį́į da nítʼééʼ, nidi kʼad éí ná chooʼį́, shí ałdóʼ shá chooʼį́.

en: But I have sent him (who is my very heart) back to you.
nv: nidi kʼad nichʼįʼ nihééhoníłʼaʼ, tʼáá shí shiyeʼ nídíłʼaʼ nahalingo akǫ́ǫ́ náhodíłʼaʼ.

en: I wanted to keep him so that he could serve me in your place during my imprisonment for the sake of the gospel.
nv: haneʼ yáʼátʼéehii baa hashneʼgo biniinaa awáalyaą́ nishłį́įgo shá nanilʼaʼ yę́ęgi shá naalʼaʼ doo nisin nítʼééʼ.

en: However without your consent I did not want to do anything, so that your good deed would not be out of compulsion, but from your own willingness.
nv: nidi íinínízinii tʼáá bídin doo haʼátʼíhída baa niséyáa da, áko doo tʼáá kʼad bíninishchéehgo shaa jiidííbaał da, nidi tʼáá ni íinínízinii bikʼehgo ádiiʼnííł.

en: For perhaps it was for this reason that he was separated from you for a little while so that you would have him back eternally,
nv: hoolʼáágóó shónáhwiidííłtʼeeł daatsʼí biniyé haa danízahjįʼ nitsʼáhoʼdeeltʼeʼ shaʼshin,

en: and no longer as a slave, but more than a slave as a dear brother! He is especially so to me, and even more so to you now, both humanly speaking and in the Lord!
nv: áádóó índa doo naalteʼ jílį́į́góó, nidi naalteʼ jílį́į́ nítʼéeʼii biláahdi átʼéego nikʼis ayóóʼííníʼníinii jílį́į dooleeł! shí shichʼįʼgo tʼáá íiyisí ákótʼéego haa nitséskees, nidi nijígo tʼéiyá tʼah aláhídi átʼéego tʼáá diné jílį́įgo áádóó bóhólníihii bee hoł háíníʼáázh jílį́įgo haa nitsíníkees dooleeł!

en: Therefore if you regard me as a partner, accept him as you would me.
nv: áko shikʼis jílį́ shííníʼníigo, tʼáá náshididííłtéłígi átʼéego nááhodidííłtééł.

en: Now if he has defrauded you of anything or owes you anything, charge what he owes to me.
nv: nichʼįʼ doo ákǫ́ǫ́ ádzaa ládą́ą́ʼ, éí doodaléiʼ bąąh háínítsi ládą́ą́ʼ éí shígo shikʼijįʼ naaltsoos bikʼi díízoh.

en: I, Paul, have written this letter with my own hand: I will repay it. I could also mention that you owe me your very self.
nv: shí paul díí shílaʼ bee akʼeʼashchí: tʼáá shí nináʼdeeshdlééł. azhą́ hinínáago bee naa háíłʼáhígíi nidi, éí doo béinidiyeeshnih da.

en: Yes brother, let me have some benefit from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart for the Lord.
nv: haaʼíshąʼ shikʼis, bóhólníihii binahjįʼ baa hózhónígi átʼéego áshidíílííł. bóhólníihii bee shikʼééhodííłtah.

en: Since I was confident that you would obey, I wrote to you because I knew that you would do even more than what I am asking you to do.
nv: akʼeh honíłʼínígíí bee naa jóshłíigo, ándishnínígíi nidi biláahgo ádííníiłgo shił bééhózingo nichʼįʼ akʼeʼashchí.

en: At the same time also, prepare a place for me to stay, for I hope that through your prayers I will be given back to you.
nv: áádóó sédáa dooleełgi ałdóʼ tʼáá áłdįįłtʼéego shá ádíílííł; shá sodadołzingo tʼah nítʼéeʼda lá tʼáá ánółtso nihaa nánísdzáa łeh nisingo bíká shił chohooʼį́.

en: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you.
nv: épafras, christ jesus baa hwiilneʼgo biniinaa bił awáalyaa sékéhígíí kʼé niłní,

en: Mark, Aristarchus, Demas and Luke, my colaborers, greet you too.
nv: mark áádóó aristárkas áádóó díímas índa luke, shił nidaalnishígíí, ałdóʼ kʼé daniłní.

en: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
nv: nihibóhólníihii jesus christ bibee ajoobaʼ nihiiʼ naazíinii yił hólǫ́ǫ leʼ. tʼáá ákótʼée doo.

en: For the believers from the elder, to an elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth I make this letter. Not I alone, but also all those who know the truth,
nv: daʼoodlání yá aląąjįʼ sizíinii nishłį́įgo, asdzání éí diyin god atsʼábiníłtíinii baʼáłchíní tʼáá bił tʼáá aaníinii binahjįʼ ayóóʼóóshʼníinii bichʼįʼ naaltsoos áshłééh. doo tʼáá shí tʼéiyá ayóóʼádanihóshʼníi da, nidi tʼáá aaníinii bił béédahózinii ałdóʼ tʼáá ałtso ayóóʼádanihóʼní,

en: because of the truth that resides in us and will be with us forever.
nv: háálá tʼáá aaníinii nihiiʼ dahólǫ́, áádóó hoolʼáágóó nihił hólǫ́ǫ dooleeł.

en: In truth and love grace from God the Father and also from Jesus Christ the Son of the Father may he bless us with peace.
nv: tʼáá aaníinii índa ayóóʼóʼóʼníinii bikʼehgo diyin god ataaʼ nilíinii índa bóhólníihii jesus christ tʼáá ataaʼ biyeʼ nilíinii bibee ajoobaʼ áádóó bibee aa aʼááh hasinii índa bibee achʼįʼ hózhǫ́ náhásdlį́įʼii yee nihikʼijidlíi doo.

en: Just as god the Father commanded us, I rejoiced greatly because I have found some of your children living according to the truth.
nv: tʼáá diyin god ataaʼ nilíinii bibikʼeh óʼooʼníiłii yee nihá hasʼánígi átʼéego naʼáłchíní łaʼ tʼáá aaníinii yikʼehgo dayíkáahgo shił bééhoozinígíí tʼáá íiyisí baa shił hózhǫ́.

en: Then indeed, my sister, not as if I were writing a new commandment to you, I ask you the command we have had from the beginning, that we love one another.
nv: áko lą́ą, shilah, bikʼeh óʼooʼníiłii ániidíii doo bee nichʼįʼ akʼeʼashchíi da, nidi daʼiisiidląąd yę́ędóó bikʼeh óʼooʼníiłii nihee dahazlį́ʼígíí, tʼáá éí bikʼehgo ayóóʼádaʼahííníiʼníi dooleełígíí baa nánooshkąąh.

en: For this love we walk according to God’s commandment, you love one another, just as the Gospel you have heard from the beginning, you should walk in it.
nv: ayóóʼóʼóʼní bee nił hashneʼígíí éí diyin god bibikʼeh óʼooʼníiłii tʼáá átʼé tsʼídá bikʼeh dahoniilʼį́į dooleełii ááhdishní. bikʼeh óʼooʼníiłii, ayóóʼádaʼahíínóhʼní, nínígíí éí haneʼ yáʼátʼéehii baa adahoʼniineʼ yę́ędą́ą́ʼ dasidootsʼą́ą́ʼ, éí bikʼeh deínóhkááh.

en: For many deceivers have gone out into the world. That, Jesus Christ coming in the flesh, the people who do not confess this person are the deceiver and the antichrist.
nv: doo tʼáá aaníígóó nidaʼnitinii tʼóó ahayóí nihokááʼgóó deíkááh. éí, jesus christ diné silį́įʼgo biʼdizhchį́, doo daaníígóó nidaʼnitin. ákójíníigo nazhʼnitinígíí éí binaʼadloʼii jílį́įgo christ biʼanaʼíjílį́.

en: Watch out, so that you do not lose the things we have worked for, but receive a full reward.
nv: éí bąą ádaa ádahołyą́, bee nidanihineetą́ąʼii tʼáá ádzaaí ádaohłeʼ lágo, áko nihichʼįʼ nidahidoolyéełii tʼáá átʼé nihichʼįʼ nidahidoolyééł.

en: Everyone who goes on ahead and does not remain in the teaching of Christ does not have God. The one who remains in this teaching has both God the Father and the Son.
nv: tʼáá háiida christ binaʼnitin doo biʼjósingóó, nidi tʼáá biláahgo bee nazhʼnitinígíí éí diyin god doo hwiiʼ hólǫ́ǫ da. tʼáá háiida christ binaʼnitin biʼjósinígíí éí diyin god ataaʼ áádóó ayeʼ nilíinii hwiiʼ hólǫ́.

en: If anyone comes to you and does not bring Christ’s teaching, do not receive him into your house and do not give him any greeting.
nv: christ binaʼnitin doo yee naʼnitinii nihaa níyáago tʼáadoo nihaʼałkʼee sidáhí doo, tʼáadoo kʼé deínóhʼníní doo.
